thread:
UT Austin edges out UH-Downtown by 1 for the most restaurants within a 10-minute walk of campus.

Every Texas college with 5,000+ students (top 14 of 38):

1. UT Austin: 115
2. UH-Downtown: 114
3. Texas State: 79
4. SMU: 62
5. North Texas: 51
6. Baylor: 49
6. Texas Tech: 49
8. UTEP: 47
9. UTRGV: 42
10. Texas A&M: 40
11. TCU: 35
11. UT Arlington: 35
13. Stephen F Austin State: 34
13. the Incarnate Word: 34

Places to eat within half a mile of each campus's center, using Overture Maps listings.

Look up any campus, with the closest places first: https://www.savorscout.net/campus/tx

GW has the most restaurants within a 10-minute walk of campus of any big university in the area. Rutgers is 98 behind.

Every DC, Maryland, Delaware and New Jersey university with 20,000+ students:

1. GW: 280
2. Rutgers: 182
3. Johns Hopkins: 76

5. Georgetown: 52
6. Maryland: 21
7. Montclair State: 8
